title: Business Development Associate (BDA)
description:
Inside Sales Specialist – International Sales

**Company:** Codeyoung  
**Role:** **Inside Sales Specialist**  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years  
**Location:** HSR Layout, Bengaluru  
**Work Mode:** Work From Office  
**Shift:** US/Night Shift  
**Working Days:** 6 Days a Week | 1 Fixed Weekly Off  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

About Codeyoung

Codeyoung is a global EdTech company focused on empowering children with future-ready skills through structured, interactive learning programs. We work with students and parents across international markets, helping learners build strong foundations in coding, mathematics, and other technology-driven skills.

About the Role

We are looking for a **Sales Specialist** who is passionate about sales, communication, and customer engagement. The ideal candidate will be responsible for connecting with prospective parents, understanding their requirements, presenting relevant learning programs, and converting qualified leads into enrollments.

This is a **target-driven international B2C sales role**, primarily catering to customers in the US market.

Key Responsibilities

* Connect with prospective customers through inbound and outbound calls.
* Understand parents' requirements and recommend suitable Codeyoung programs.
* Conduct product demonstrations and counselling sessions with parents.
* Effectively communicate the value proposition of Codeyoung's programs.
* Follow up with prospective customers through calls, WhatsApp, email, and other channels.
* Manage the complete sales cycle from lead qualification to conversion.
* Achieve individual weekly and monthly sales targets.
* Maintain accurate and updated customer information in the CRM.
* Build strong relationships with parents and prospective customers.
* Handle objections and resolve customer concerns effectively.
* Maintain consistent follow-up with warm and interested leads.
* Collaborate with the counselling and operations teams to ensure a smooth enrollment experience.
* Track sales performance and continuously work on improving conversion rates.

Requirements

* 1–3 years of experience in **B2C Sales, Inside Sales, EdTech Sales, Telesales, or Counselling**.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong convincing, negotiation, and objection-handling abilities.
* Comfortable working with sales targets and performance metrics.
* Customer-focused approach with strong interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple leads and follow-ups effectively.
* Good working knowledge of CRM systems and basic MS Office/Google Workspace.
* Willingness to work in a **US/night shift** and from the Bengaluru office.
* Candidates with experience in **international sales or US market sales** will be preferred.

Key Skills

**B2C Sales | Inside Sales | International Sales | EdTech Sales | Lead Conversion | Counselling | Negotiation | Objection Handling | CRM | Customer Relationship Management | Target Achievement**

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work with a growing global EdTech company.
* Exposure to international B2C sales and the US market.
* Performance-driven growth opportunities.
* Dynamic and fast-paced work environment.
* Opportunity to build strong sales and customer-management skills.

Who Should Apply?

We are looking for **high-energy, target-oriented sales professionals** who enjoy interacting with customers, are confident in handling objections, and are motivated by achieving and exceeding sales targets.

**If you are passionate about sales and want to build your career in international B2C sales, we would love to hear from you.**

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

title: Process Excellence and Transformation- Associate
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

You are a strategic thinker passionate about driving measurable efficiency and transformation across CCB F&BM. Yes? You have found the right team.

As a Senior Associate, Process Excellence & Transformation within CCB Finance & Business Management (F&BM), you will spend each day building a centralized, persona-driven engagement model and creating a single source of truth for transformation use cases. You will be responsible for delivering quantifiable improvements through AI use cases, standardized governance, disciplined program/project management, and Lean (DMAIC) practices.

Our CCB F&BM transformation teams are responsible for a wide range of activities including identifying and prioritizing efficiency opportunities across sub‑LOBs, establishing consistent operating models and governance routines, and executing change that improves outcomes in a sustainable, well-controlled way.

Job Responsibilities
Build and maintain a living “golden resource” linking Team Technology

* Change Journey across sub‑LOBs.
* Design and operationalize a centralized, persona-driven engagement model, mapping job families to impacted users, themes, and adoption requirements.
* Source, intake, and prioritize thematic efficiency and AI transformation use cases across sub‑LOBs using standardized forms and processes.
* Document team/tool ownership, impacted processes, current status, and a 12–24 month roadmap to create a single source of truth.
  + Scale proof-of-concept work into production-ready artifacts that can be used in strategy discussions and before launching new use cases.
  + Align priorities and outcomes with sub‑LOB leadership (N‑1), clarifying ownership, decisions, and success measures.
* Standardize execution through Agile discipline and governance routines, including JIRA hygiene, review checkpoints, and timely sign-offs.
* Partner with Controls stakeholders to align initiatives to Controls OKRs, streamline SOPs, and identify control-aligned efficiency opportunities.
* Coordinate delivery with STO/execution partners by managing dependencies, tracking progress, and escalating risks and delays.
* Maintain a single authoritative repository for historical, current, and pipeline transformation work and enable leadership visibility via JIRA dashboards.
* Lead Lean (DMAIC) deep-dives to deliver measurable, systemic improvements with sub‑LOB sign-off and adoption.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

* Demonstrate 6+ years of experience in process excellence, transformation, program/project management, or operational strategy (financial services beneficial).
* Lead cross-functional workstreams with senior stakeholder alignment, including N‑1 engagement and decision-making.
* Active development experience to build solutions using IS solutions- Python, Pyspark, Alteryx
* Execute disciplined intake-to-delivery lifecycle management, including governance cadence, dependency/risk management, and closure.
* Apply hands-on Agile delivery practices and use JIRA for tracking, reporting, and dashboarding.
* Communicate clearly in writing and verbally, including executive-ready updates and crisp decision asks.
* Build and sustain an adopted “golden resource” mapping Team–Tool–Process–Change Journey with a 12–24 month outlook.
* Deliver measurable outcomes through standardized operating models, reusable repositories, and end-to-end workstreams with documented stakeholder buy-in.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

* Active development experience to build solutions using IS solutions- Databricks, Snowflake, Atoti, Sigma, Tableau
  + Apply exposure to intelligent automation and analytics enablement and adoption in enterprise environments.
* Hold Lean Six Sigma certification (Green Belt/Black Belt) or demonstrate successful DMAIC delivery experience.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  
  
Our Consumer & Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.

title: Operations Associate
description:
**Job Title:** Operations Associate

**Company:** Saturn Labs

**Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka (On-site)

**Job Type:** Full-time

**Salary:** ₹6,00,000 - ₹12,00,000 a year

Full Job Description

Role Overview

We are looking for an execution-focused Operations Associate to join our team in Bengaluru. In this role, you will be on the ground managing daily data collection pipelines, supervising field operators and annotators, enforcing quality control processes, and tracking operational throughput.

This role requires a high bias for action, comfort with ambiguity, and a willingness to handle frontline operational challenges in a fast-paced technology startup.

Key Responsibilities

* **Daily Ground Execution:** Coordinate daily physical data collection schedules involving motion capture, multi-view camera tracking, and sensor rigs. Ensure setup readiness and basic equipment calibration before daily sessions begin.
* **Workforce & Vendor Coordination:** Manage attendance, task allocations, and daily outputs for field operators, annotators, and third-party contributors. Assist in recording vendor deliverables and tracking milestone payments against agreed SLAs.
* **Quality Assurance & SOP Compliance:** Implement and monitor standard operating procedures (SOPs) across collection pods. Perform first-pass data quality checks to identify capture issues, labeling gaps, or data anomalies before delivery to research teams.
* **Reporting & Tracking:** Maintain daily MIS reports, operational dashboards, and inventory logs using MS Excel and Google Sheets. Track throughput, turnaround time (TAT), and resource utilization to highlight bottlenecks to leadership.
* **On-Ground Troubleshooting:** Resolve real-time procedural and operational blockers to minimize collection downtime.

Qualifications and Skills

* **Experience:** 1 to 3 years of hands-on experience in startup operations, field operations, logistics, or tech-enabled delivery environments.
* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in any discipline (Engineering, Science, or Operations Management preferred).
* **Technical Skills:** Strong proficiency in MS Excel / Google Sheets (pivot tables, formulas, data tracking).
* **Location & Availability:** Must be currently based in Bengaluru (or able to relocate immediately) and able to work on-site full-time.
* **Core Competencies:** Strong organization skills, process discipline, clear communication, and comfort working directly on the floor.

Preferred Qualifications

* Prior experience with data labeling/annotation workflows, computer vision, robotics, or hardware sensor setups.
* Prior experience managing field staff, blue/grey-collar workforces, or vendor networks.

Benefits

* Competitive compensation (₹6 LPA to ₹12 LPA based on experience)
* Uncapped performance-linked incentives
* Fast-track growth opportunities in a high-growth Physical AI startup
* Direct mentorship from experienced operations and engineering leadership

Schedule

* Day shift
* Monday to Friday (with weekend operational coverage as required by project milestones)

Ability to Commute/Relocate

* Bengaluru, Karnataka: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Pay: ₹600,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Brand Marketing Executive
description:
**Brand Management Associate – Amazon**

**Location: Bangalore**  
**About the Role:-**

Own the day-to-day growth of brands on Amazon by combining marketplace expertise, analytical thinking, and operational excellence. As a Brand Management Associate, you will work closely with brands to optimize their presence, improve business performance, and drive sustainable growth across Amazon.

**About New Trends Commerce**

New Trends Commerce Private Limited is a Poddar Group Company with Amazon Investment. Our vision is to be the most trusted go-to-market partner for businesses, empowering them to establish and grow their digital ventures efficiently and costeffectively. We achieve this through a customer-focused approach, sales expertise, a highperformance culture, and technology-powered sales strategies. Our end-to-end go-tomarket solutions include marketplace management, sales strategy, catalog optimization, advertising, sales automation, execution, and customer retention. Our teams are guided by strong Leadership Principles, customer obsession, ownership, innovation, and operational excellence to deliver outstanding business outcomes.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly analytical and execution-focused Brand Management Associate to manage and grow brands on Amazon. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central or Vendor Central and a strong understanding of marketplace operations. This role requires ownership of day-to-day account performance, catalog management, advertising coordination, inventory planning, and business reporting.

**Responsibilities**  
1. Manage end-to-end operations for Amazon Seller Central and/or Vendor Central accounts. 2. Create, optimize, and maintain product listings, A+ Content, Brand Stores, images, keywords, and catalog quality to improve discoverability and conversions. 3. Monitor key business metrics including sales, traffic, conversion rate, Buy Box ownership, inventory health, account health, and customer experience. 4. Plan and execute promotional campaigns, Lightning Deals, Best Deals, and seasonal events to maximize sales performance. 5. Coordinate with internal teams across catalog, content, advertising, pricing, and operations to ensure smooth marketplace execution. 6. Work closely with advertising teams to improve campaign performance, ROAS, ACOS, and overall marketplace visibility. 7. Analyze category performance, customer behavior, competitor activities, and marketplace trends to identify growth opportunities. 8. Resolve operational issues related to listings, suppressed ASINs, inventory, pricing, and account performance in a timely manner. 9. Prepare weekly and monthly business reviews with actionable insights and recommendations for brand growth. 10.Maintain accurate documentation of marketplace activities, performance reports, and action plans

**Basic Qualifications**  
1. Bachelor's degree. 2. 1–3 years of experience managing Amazon marketplace accounts at an ecommerce agency, D2C brand, marketplace, or online retail business. 3. Hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central and/or Vendor Central. 4. Strong understanding of catalog management, listing optimization, account health, promotions, and inventory management. 5. Working knowledge of Amazon Advertising metrics such as ACOS, ROAS, CTR, CPC, and conversion rate. 6. Advanced Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and dashboard creation. 7. Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills. 8. Ability to manage multiple brands and prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing multiple brands across different product categories. **Familiarity with Amazon Brand Registry, A+ Content, Brand Stores, and marketplace analytics tools.**  Experience working with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar to improve productivity and business analysis. **Customer-first mindset with a strong sense of ownership and attention to detail.**

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund
